item.title: A tiny world model running games on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W
item.description:
📝 Every frame above was sampled by the world model network, and the actions were taken by the actor network. On the chip neither network ever uses the real game: the actor only sees frames the world model, and the world model only gets actions from the actor. game frame rules random event world model exact frames, 2 loops Breakout 20×16 paddle, ball, 56 bricks, 5 lives the serve after a miss 26k params, 4.

item.description:

item.title: Sylphide OS: a general-purpose OS for microcontroller-based computers
item.description:
📝 Sylphide OS is a general-purpose Operating system for computers made from microcontrollers (MCU). Some are developing software, usually games, using modern computers and software, but targeting old computers. This project is about yet another way: computers using modern microcontollers.
🔗 Read more: https://projects.freehackers.org/sylphide-os/

item.title: ElementaryUI – Swift, in the Browser
item.description:
📝 Run declarative Swift applications natively in the browser with WebAssembly Automatic state management with @State, @Environment, and @Reactive Full Embedded Swift support means kB-sized wasm bundles instead of MB Powerful CSS-based animation system including automatic FLIP transitions Fast dev server with hot reload for rapid iteration Thank you to everyone supporting this open‑source project financially. Please consider joining them by sponsoring ElementaryUI.
🔗 Read more: https://elementary.codes

item.title: Alleged Chinese spy had 'close relationship' with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang
item.description:
📝 5 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was photographed drinking whiskey with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman accused of passing intelligence to Beijing, at a Taipei bar in June 2024. 5 Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le. item.title: The importance of communities around software
item.description:
📝 The community around a software project is what dictates the values of the project. This is why I don't care as much anymore about a project being under a copyleft free software license or a non-copyleft free software license. These are communities of people that develop software together.
🔗 Read more: https://lumi.codeberg.page/blog/software-community.html
